name: Recital
title: Recital

legal_basis.note: Consideration: an act done at the desire of the promisor
An agreement without consideration is void, subject to the exceptions

authoring_note: The recital must show why the indemnity was given, because that is the consideration for it. A bond that recites no occasion and no reliance by the Beneficiary invites the argument that it is a bare promise without consideration and void under Section 25.
